snp1.4:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Magadhesu viharati Dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ Ekanālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme.
snp1.4:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa pañcamattāni naṅgalasatāni payuttāni honti vappakāle.
snp1.4:1.4: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ mivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa kammanto ten' upasaṃkami.
snp1.4:1.5: Tena kho pana samayena Kasibhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa parivesanā vattati.
snp1.4:1.6: Atha kho Bhagavā vena parivesanā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
snp1.4:2.1: Addasā kho Kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ piṇḍāya ṭhitaṃ,
snp1.4:2.3: "ahaṃ kho samaṇa kasāmi ca vapāmi ca, kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmi,
snp1.4:2.4: tvam pi samana kasassu ca vapassu ca, kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjassū" ti.
snp1.4:3.1: "Aham pi kho brāhmaṇa kasāmi ca vapāmi ca, kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmī" ti.
snp1.4:3.2: "Na kho pana mayaṃ passāma bhoto Gotamassa yugaṃ vā naṅgalaṃ vā phālaṃ vā pācanaṃ vā balivadde vā,
snp1.4:3.3: atha ca pana bhavaṃ Gotamo evam āha:
snp1.4:3.4: aham pi kho brāhmaṇa kasāmi ca vapāmi ca, kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmī" ti.
snp1.4:4.1: Atha kho Kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi: 76.
snp1.4:10.1: Atha kho Kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo mahativā kaṃsapātivā pāyāsaṃ vaḍḍhetvā Bhagavato upanāmese:
snp1.4:10.4: yaṃ hi bhavaṃ Gotamo amataphalaṃ kasiṃ kasatī" ti. 81.
snp1.4:12.4: khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekhassa hotī" ti.
snp1.4:13.1: "Atha kassacābaṃ bho Gotama imaṃ pāyāsaṃ dammī" ti.
snp1.4:13.2: "Na kho 'han taṃ brāhmaṇa passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yassa so pāyāso bhutto sammāpariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra Tathāgatassa vā Tathāgatasāvakassa vā,
snp1.4:13.3: tena hi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa taṃ pāyāsaṃ appaharite vā chaṭṭehi appāṇake vā udake opilāpehī" ti.
snp1.4:14.1: Atha kho Kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo taṃ pāyāsaṃ appāṇake udake opilāpesi.
snp1.4:14.2: Atha kho so pāyāso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati citiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati.
snp1.4:14.3: Seyyathā pi nāma phālo divasasantatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati,
snp1.4:14.4: evam eva so pāyāso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati.
snp1.4:15.1: Atha kho Kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
snp1.4:15.3: seyyathā pi bho Gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī' ti, evam evam bhotā Gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
snp1.4:15.4: Esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
snp1.4:15.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhoto Gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan" ti.
snp1.4:16.1: Alattha kho Kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
snp1.4:16.2: Acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā Bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirass' eva, yass' atthāya kulaputtā samma-d-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi,
snp1.4:16.3: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā' ti abbhaññāsi.
snp1.4:16.4: Aññataro ca kho panāyasmā Bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosī ti
